messages:
irina: Pinging the docs crew Opening a concise PR to tighten guidance for 429/timeouts and context-limit fallbacks. Goal: one short recommended pattern + tiny py/js snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310
devon: LGTM. Suggest we coin a short term 'grace window' and call out that fallback is opt-in (not automatic). also add one-line 'when to choose fallback' guidance.
maya: Ops request: include a 3-step troubleshooting checklist (synthetic repro command, KV cache hit-rate check, model-selection log grep). keep it compact.
irina: noted. Adding a synthetic repro line (labelled "synthetic repro") and a tiny ops checklist. Also will add "Known limitations": streaming might not carry over when switching models mid-request, and cache warmness may be lost.
devon: SDK teams note: for now we don't expose a fallback_model param. Show explicit retry+reissue pattern. Example (py):
```python
try:
    resp = client.generate(model="redwood-giant", input=input_text)
except TooManyRequestsError:
    time.sleep(backoff_with_jitter())
    resp = client.generate(model="redwood-small", input=input_text)
```
And JS:```js
try {
  const r = await client.generate({model: 'redwood-giant', input})
} catch (e) {
  await sleep(backoffWithJitter())
  const r2 = await client.generate({model: 'redwood-small', input})
}
```
maya: billing FYI: I'll confirm whether tokens are billed at attempted model or final served model and update the PR. If billed at attempted model, we should warn customers to monitor costs during retries.
docs-bot: PR #1310 created by irina. lint: OK. link-check: pending. preview: staging at 2026-03-23T09:12:00Z.
irina: small ask: include a one-line FAQ: "Should I enable fallback?" Answer: "Opt-in; use when latency SLOs matter more than top-end quality; validate with your prompts."
devon: also add an ops reproduction command (synthetic repro):
```bash
hey load -c 180 -n 400 "curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-giant\",\"input\":\"test\"}'"
```
keep it clearly labelled.
irina: will merge once billing confirms wording. thanks all :rocket:
